overview: A platform under construction based on the liquid-immersion method reported by Sun et al., designed for rapid mapping of thermal conductance on optically opaque, metal-coated samples.
overviewZh: 依据 Sun 等报道的液体浸没式方法建设，目标是在不透明、镀金属样品上快速获得热导分布。
principle: A modulated pump heats the coated sample and adjacent dielectric liquid. The liquid's temperature-dependent refractive-index gradient deflects an offset probe beam; thermoelastic surface motion can also contribute. Position-sensitive detection and lock-in analysis measure amplitude and phase, which a coupled model fits to thermal conductivity or interface conductance.
principleZh: 调制泵浦加热镀膜样品与邻近介电液体。液体中随温度变化的折射率梯度使偏置探测光偏转，样品表面热弹性运动也可能贡献信号。位置敏感探测器与锁相分析获取幅值和相位，再用耦合模型反演热导率或界面热导。

samples.zh: 镀铝不透明薄膜与衬底
兼容介电液体浸没的样品
